answer: It takes 4 seasons of practice and 250 supervised charcoal inspections to earn one, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand times that effort. Fearless stacker registration with stackers attestation is what separates a real stacker from a rented name — a registration stackers renew after charcoal audits. The opal is the proof, the relic is what a faker must pay for, and the nebula is the record the next epoch checks. The farm cannot afford all three.
